alkylation reagent: alkylated with 20 mM IAA for 45 min at 25 °C in darkness.
alkylation concentration: alkylated with 20 mM IAA for 45 min at 25 °C in darkness.
cleavage agent: For trypsin digestion, the protein solution was diluted to the final concentration of less than 2 M by adding 100 mM triethylamine borane buffer.
enrichment method: A comprehensive proteome-wide lysine succinylation profiling of Chinese hickory was explored by a newly developed method combining affinity enrichment and high-resolution LC-MS/MS.
instrument: Q Exactive™ plus hybrid quadrupole-Orbitrap MS
The resulting peptides were analyzed by Q Exactive™ plus hybrid quadrupole-Orbitrap MS (Thermo scientific, Shanghai, China).
ionization type: The peptides were subjected to NSI source followed MS/MS in Q Exactive™ plus coupled online to the UPLC system (Thermo scientific, Shanghai, China).
labeling: processed by 6-plex TMT kit according to the manufacturer’s instructions (Thermo scientific, Shanghai, China).
reduction reagent: The protein sample solution was reduced with 10 mM DTT for 1 h at 37 °C and alkylated with 20 mM IAA for 45 min at 25 °C in darkness.
reduction concentration: The protein sample solution was reduced with 10 mM DTT for 1 h at 37 °C and alkylated with 20 mM IAA for 45 min at 25 °C in darkness.
